ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) clusters comprising approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white punctate blobs distributed stochastically across the left lobe and the proximal section of the right lobe; distal right lobe remains uniform low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a pixel angle approximately 130-140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities. The left lobe trailing edge is characterized by a significant terminal truncation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows an elongated convex curve tapering to a tip. Left lobe follows a convex curve that is abruptly terminated.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (mottling) are densely packed on the left lobe and at the base of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The left fluke lobe exhibits a severe terminal amputation or tissue loss, resulting in a jagged, blunt outer edge lacking the natural tapering tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between lobes due to the missing distal section of the left fluke.
